criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to problems with card usage, acceptance, or functionality.

categories.name: Fraud and Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized charges or potential fraud on the account.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests for changes or updates to account details or settings.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the process or requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Card Delivery and Activation
categories.definition: Inquiries about the status of card delivery or how to activate a new card.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Questions about fees or charges applied to transactions or account activities.

categories.name: Currency and Exchange Rates
categories.definition: Queries about currency options, exchange rates, and related fees.

categories.name: Transfers and Payments
categories.definition: Issues or questions related to transferring money or making payments.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems or questions about adding funds to the account.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an account.

categories.name: Virtual and Disposable Cards
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining or using virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: ATM and Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Problems or questions related to ATM usage or cash withdrawals.

categories.name: Refunds and Disputes
categories.definition: Requests for refunds or disputes over transactions.

categories.name: Account Access Issues
categories.definition: Problems accessing the account or app, including login issues.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: Requests for general information about services, policies, or procedures.
